# @arki/mail

> Typed mail for TypeScript: templates typed by any Standard Schema, transports that never throw or invent ids, quota-aware failover that never sends twice after a timeout, and mail queued in the caller's transaction on `@arki/journal`.

## Import paths
- `@arki/mail`: `mailer`, `defineTemplate`, `renderTemplate`, `failover`, `logTransport`, `inMemoryQuotaStore`, `kvQuotaStore`, the failures (`MailInvalidInput`, `MailQuotaExhausted`, `MailRejected`, `MailUncertain`, `MailExpired`), `MailError`, `isMailError`, `MAIL_ERROR_CODES`, and the types (`Mailer`, `MailTemplate`, `MailTransport`, `MailMessage`, `SentMail`, `SendOptions`).
- `@arki/mail/templates/auth`: `magicLink`, `verifyEmail`, `resetPassword`, `signInCode`.
- `@arki/mail/http/resend`: `resend`.
- `@arki/mail/http/unosend`: `unosend`.
- `@arki/mail/http/cloudflare`: `cloudflare`.
- `@arki/mail/node/ses`: `ses` (needs `@aws-sdk/client-sesv2`).
- `@arki/mail/react`: `renderReact`.
- `@arki/mail/react/templates/magic-link`: `MagicLinkEmail`.
- `@arki/mail/react/templates/magic-link-minimal`: `MagicLinkMinimalEmail`.
- `@arki/mail/pg`: `mailOutbox`, `MAIL_JOB`, `MailTx`.
- `@arki/mail/pg/testing`: `mailQueueAssertions`.
- `@arki/mail/dot`: `mail`, `mailOutboxPlugin`, `mailJobs`.
- `@arki/mail/testing`: `mailSink`, `transportContract`.

## Rules that bite
- `send` returns the `SentMail` or a failure value; it does not throw for a mail that was not sent. Check with `isFailure` from `@arki/failure`.
- `text` is required on every template.
- When every transport is over quota, nothing is sent (`MailQuotaExhausted`). Add a transport without a quota for an unlimited fallback.
- `failover` never tries a second provider after a timeout (`MailUncertain`). The journal retries later instead.
- `mailOutbox.enqueue` needs a transaction (`E009` for the root db) and exactly one `to` recipient.
- A message id may be `null`. Never use it as a key without checking.
